# PROCESS — what I did this iteration (explainability; REQUIRED)

## Summary decision
**No capability edit shipped this iteration — deliberately.** All 10 val tasks aborted at
Docker sandbox BUILD time with an identical network error; the agent and the skill packages
never executed. There is zero behavioral signal, so no edit can pass the REAL or VERIFIED
tests. A speculative edit would add regression risk (once infra recovers) for no possible
gain (re-scoring hits the same dead network → net-zero → gate rejects). I diagnosed fully,
confirmed there is nothing actionable, and completed the handover files.

## Ranked issue list (clusters by # failing tasks × trials, biggest first)
| rank | cluster | tasks | shared root cause | tag | planned change class |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | Docker sandbox build failure (INFRA, not capability) | all 10 (exceltable-in-ppt, financial-modeling-qa, invoice-fraud-detection, offer-letter-generator, pdf-excel-diff, pptx-reference-formatting, reserves-at-risk-calc, sales-pivot-analysis, weighted-gdp-calc, xlsx-recover-data) | `FROM ubuntu:24.04` image pull fails: `dial tcp: lookup registry-1.docker.io: i/o timeout` at image-build time; 100% of trials fail during sandbox startup, before any rollout | INFRA-NOISE (uncontrollable) | NONE — cannot be fixed by a capability edit |

There are no capability clusters (KNOWLEDGE / BEHAVIORAL / CAPABILITY-GAP) — every failure is
the framework's own listed infrastructure error.

## Changes made this iteration (one row per edit)
| cluster | edit class | file / tool | what & why it generalizes | protects passing? |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| (none) | (none) | (none) | No trajectory contains agent behavior; every REAL/VERIFIED test fails by construction. | n/a — 0 solid/flaky/failing tasks exist |

## Verify-the-fix (one line per change)
- N/A — no changes. Every trace has `tool_calls=[]`, `output=None`, `trace=None`, `tokens=«redacted»
  `reward=0.0`; the failure is `failed to solve: ... registry-1.docker.io: i/o timeout` at
  Dockerfile line 1 (`FROM ubuntu:24.04`). There is nothing to verify a fix against.

## Process & features used
- Subagents / worktrees / parallel features used: not used — single-pass diagnosis was
  sufficient because the failure signature is identical across all 10 traces and is
  unambiguously infrastructure, not capability. Fanning out subagents would only re-confirm
  the same empty traces at extra cost.
- Prior iterations read from ./prior_iterations/ + ./RUNMAP.md: none exist (this is the seed
  baseline; RUNMAP / LEDGER / prior_iterations are all empty).

## Good things to PRESERVE (do not let a future iteration undo these)
- The skill packages (docx / pdf / pptx / xlsx SKILL.md + bundled scripts) are structurally
  intact and valid. Because they never ran, there is NO evidence any part of them is wrong. A
  future iteration must NOT "clean up" or reword them on speculation — wait for real
  trajectories that contain agent behavior before touching them.

## Deliberately skipped (cluster + why — already-passing / needs gold / infra noise)
- All 10 tasks: uncontrollable Docker/network infrastructure error (registry-1.docker.io DNS
  timeout at image build). Explicitly flagged by the framework as infra noise; no capability
  edit can move them. The re-score will hit the same broken network, so any candidate is
  net-zero — the only correct move is to not add regression risk.
